rows.text: After obtaining a more powerful divine treasure, you achieve many great deeds, and your bond with it grows even stronger. Poets compose ballads, spreading tales of your feats. A sacred sense of purpose rises from deep within: You are destined to forge true legends with it.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Myths and legends weave a web, guiding you to your fated destination. You climb to the mountain's peak at night, to the place closest to the stars and gods, and kneel in prayer.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Few have made it this far." The voice echoes from the stars, "You can still rise higher, but it will come at a certain cost..."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Your wounds heal in an instant. The pantheon has accepted this offering. The thick clouds part, letting gentle moonlight pour down as warmth and power surge through your body. You feel more invigorated than ever before, like a vessel filled to the brim.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: There was a tale told in the city of Icatus: A carpenter crafted a sculpture so masterful it seemed divine, yet he lived forever in its shadow, never able to create anything better. On his deathbed, he destroyed his masterpiece with his own hands and died with a smile on his face.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Your voice grows ever more resonant. The divine has accepted this offering. The thick clouds part, letting gentle moonlight pour down as warmth and power surge through your body. You feel more invigorated than ever before, like a vessel filled to the brim.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Your voice grows increasingly hoarse. It's the gods' subtle refusal. You smile wryly and take the hint, getting up to leave. Your time hasn't come yet.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The divine treasure is a rare and powerful tool, but it can also become a shackle, an obsession. You beg the gods to take back their blessing. The thick clouds disperse as gentle moonlight pours down. When you open your eyes, the divine treasure has vanished, but something is left at your feet.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Moonlight shines upon your path of departure. When the time is right, you can still rise higher.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
